question: The nineteenth century saw the golden age of ____ under the patronage of Wajid Ali Shah.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the classical dances of India.
 
• Kathak dance originated from Uttar Pradesh (U.P) in North India.
 
• It was primarily a temple or village performance wherein the dancers narrated stories from ancient scriptures.
 
• Usually a solo performance, the dancer often pauses to recite verses followed by their execution through movement.
 
• Kathak is the only form of classical dance that belongs to North Indian music.
 
• The foundations of Kathak are rooted in Natya Shastra
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b0ad56825d694bd7dd609d9c597208d85b4a4129944d7a06a17e33eb37ad93e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi currently confers classical status on Nine Indian classical dance styles:-

 
 
• Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu)
 
• Kathak (North, West and Central India)
 
• Kathakali (Kerala)
 
• Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh)
 
• Odissi (Orissa)
 
• Manipuri (Manipur)
 
• Mohiniyattam (Kerala)
 
• Sattriya (Assam)
 
• **Chhau (**Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal) 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ​The Cultural Ministry of India has included Chhau in the list of classical dances making a total of 8 classical dance forms.
